## Summary
- enable injection of extra bundle metadata via `BundleGenerator`
- document custom metadata in `bundle_layout.md`
- test passing custom metadata when generating a bundle

## Testing

- `pytest -q 2>&1 | head -n 20`

- `pyright | head -n 20`
